title: Module 21: XSS, CSRF, ReDoS & Denial of Service Defense (All Chapters)
description: Comprehensive module-level assessment covering all chapters of Module 21: XSS, CSRF, ReDoS & Denial of Service Defense.

cards.concept: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) & Content Security Policy: Content Security Policy (CSP) & XSS Defense
cards.question: How does a strict Content Security Policy (CSP) header protect Node.js applications against Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)?

options.text: It minifies all JavaScript before sending to the client.
It restricts the sources from which scripts, styles, and assets can be loaded and executed, prohibiting unsafe inline scripts unless signed with valid nonces or hashes.
It encrypts browser cookie jars.
It blocks cross-origin fetch requests from Node.js servers.

cards.explanation: CSP HTTP response headers define trusted domains for script execution and disable inline script execution (<script>alert(1)</script>) unless authorized via cryptographic nonces.
cards.pitfall: Using `'unsafe-inline'` or `'unsafe-eval'` in CSP directives completely negates XSS protections.
cards.citation: MDN Web Docs: Content Security Policy / OWASP CSP Cheat Sheet

cards.concept: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) & Content Security Policy: ReDoS: Catastrophic Backtracking
cards.question: What regular expression pattern characteristic causes catastrophic backtracking (ReDoS) on the single-threaded Node.js event loop?

options.text: Using unicode character classes.
Nested or overlapping quantifiers (e.g. `(a+)+$` or `(a|a)+$`) that evaluate exponential O(2^N) paths against non-matching inputs.
Patterns longer than 128 characters.
Using the case-insensitive `/i` flag.

cards.explanation: Non-deterministic finite automata (NFA) engines explore exponential branch permutations when matching non-matching inputs with nested quantifiers, freezing the single thread.
cards.pitfall: Evaluating user-supplied regular expressions without validation or timeouts blocks all concurrent requests on the server.
cards.citation: OWASP Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) Cheat Sheet
